items.title: Clark Terry interviewed by Joe Williams and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, May 19, 1995
items.q: You came through there with Gerald Wilson’s band I think. ... We used to play softball in the park every morning.

ctx.x: You came through there with Gerald Wilson’s band I think.
I came through with Gerals Wilson. With Ella Fitzgerald.
We used to play softball in the park every morning. We’d get off at like four or five o’clock in the morning —
